short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may scan the target network to find vulnerable services and open ports.
related_observables: High volume of port connection attempts
likelihood_indicators: Bursts of traffic to unused ports
confidence_notes: High confidence if matching known scanner signatures.

attack_phase: Phase 2 & Phase 7 - Access via Remote Services
short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may leverage external-facing remote services (like VPNs) to gain initial access.
related_observables: Unexpected source IPs logging into remote services
impact_indicators: Access to internal network or DMZ
confidence_notes: Requires correlation with T1078 (Valid Accounts) for high confidence.

short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts to access resources.
impact_indicators: Access to sensitive systems as a valid user
confidence_notes: Difficult to distinguish from legitimate use without context.

short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities to gain higher-level privileges.
impact_indicators: Attacker gains root or SYSTEM level access
confidence_notes: High confidence if exploit payload or exploit behavior is detected.

technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify System Firewall
short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may modify system firewalls to bypass controls and allow malicious traffic.
likelihood_indicators: Commands like iptables -F or netsh advfirewall set
confidence_notes: High confidence; legitimate admins rarely disable firewalls completely on production.

short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of network connections to understand the network.
likelihood_indicators: Execution of discovery commands by non-admin users
impact_indicators: Attacker gains network awareness for lateral movement
confidence_notes: Medium confidence; can be noisy depending on environment.

short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may manipulate products or product delivery mechanisms prior to receipt by a final consumer for the purpose of data or system compromise.
likelihood_indicators: Unexpected binaries downloaded from trusted vendor domains
impact_indicators: Widespread compromise across vendor customer base
confidence_notes: High severity but often difficult to detect until disclosed.

short_defensive_explanation: Adversaries may wipe or corrupt disk data to disrupt availability.
likelihood_indicators: Execution of tools like dd or shred on critical drives
confidence_notes: High confidence when destructive operations are observed.
